programme.title: Ne voli me
programme.desc: Usamljeni romanopisac pokušava da pronađe ljubav i smisao života uprkos katastrofalnim i komičnim situacijama.

programme.title: Pesnica Pravde 2: Smrtonosni Izbor
programme.desc: Penzionisani ubica, Džek Li, napušta život pun nasilja kako bi odgajao Džejmi, ćerku svog pokojnog brata. Kada šef mafije, Banduči, otme Džejmi radi osvete, Džek ponovo koristi svoje smrtonosne veštine i ulice San Franciska postaju bojno polje za jednog čoveka, mašinu za ubijanje i nemilosrdnu grupu šefova mafije.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Vellčanstveni Ambersonovi
programme.desc: Razmaženo derište, Džordž Amberson, užasnut je kada njegova majka, odnedavno udovica, obnovi vezu s imućnim Judžinom Morganom, koga je ostavila nekoliko decenija ranije, kako bi se udala za Džordžovog oca. Dok se Džordž trudi da sabotira romansu svoje majke, mora se nositi i sa sopstvenim osećanjima prema Morganovoj ćerci.

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Olimpijski snovi
programme.desc: U Olimpijskom selu sportista mlada skijašica se zbližava sa volonterom dok se završava njen takmičarski nastup.

programme.title: Istina o lažima
programme.desc: Gilbi se zatiče u zamršenoj mreži laži, jer je istinu preteško priznati, a još teže prihvatiti.

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Ubojita magija
programme.desc: Na turneji po Britaniji 1926. godine, Hari Hudini započinje strastvenu vezu sa vidovnjakinjom koja namerava da prevari sjajnog mađioničara.

programme.title: Poslednja potera
programme.desc: Godine 1909, Vili Boj i njegova voljena Karlota beže nakon što on u kobnom sukobu slučajno usmrti njenog oca. Dok se predsednik Taft sprema da poseti ovu oblast, lokalni šerif i dvojica indijanskih tragača kreću u poteru za čovekom kog smatraju ubicom svog plemenskog vođe.

programme.title: Nikad neću biti tvoja
programme.desc: Majka započinje vezu s mlađim muškarcem, dok se njena ćerka prvi put zaljubljuje. Ipak, sudbina će tu umešati prste i poigrati se njihovim životima.

programme.title: Ljubavni brodolom
programme.desc: Na krstarenju Karibima, Dženi ostaje nasukana na jednoj obali sa svojim rokenrol idolom. Očarana idejom da će neko vreme provesti nasamo s njim, uspeva da sakrije činjenicu da se nalaze na samo nekoliko koraka od svog odmarališta.

programme.title: Veliki medved
programme.desc: "Big Bear" je priča o Džou, koji nevoljno odlazi na svoje momačko veče iako ga je verenica upravo ostavila zbog nekog tipa.

programme.title: Izgubljeno vreme
programme.desc: "Sećanje" je fantastična ljubavna priča koja se odvija usred užasa nemačkog koncentracionog logora u Poljskoj, 1944. godine. Ovu nemoguću strast potpaljuje hrabrost poljskog zatvorenika, koji uspeva da spase svoju devojku, Jevrejku. Neočekivano, beže iz logora i preživljavaju opasan put u slobodu. Ali tokom haosa na kraju rata se razdvajaju i jedno za drugo misle da nisu preživeli. Više od trideset godina kasnije u Njujorku, srećno udata 52-godišnja žena, slučajno otkriva da je njen voljeni Poljak još uvek živ i želi da ga vidi.

programme.title: Utvrđivanje smrti
programme.desc: Kako bi pobegao od ogromnih kockarskih dugova, veoma odbojni Ris Vilijams odlučuje da inscenira sopstvenu smrt, uz pomoć dugogodišnje sapatnice, supruge Kejti. Kad Ris "umre", Kejti nasleđuje pet miliona dolara od polise osiguranja, što će im pomoći da otplate dugove i započnu novi život na nekom drugom mestu. Ali, da li je moguće da prevara krene po zlu, a Ris završi zaista mrtav? Risova svastika, Džini, mogla bi obezbediti validne informacije agentima osiguranja, Loganu i Meku, od kojih je jedan zaljubljen u Kejti.

programme.title: The Inspector General
programme.desc: An illiterate stooge in a traveling medicine show wanders into a strange town and is picked up on a vagrancy charge. The town's corrupt officials mistake him for the inspector general whom they think is traveling in disguise. Fearing he will discover they've been pocketing tax money, they make several bungled attempts to kill him.

programme.title: The Admiral Was a Lady
programme.desc: Ex-WAVE encounters four fun-loving, work-hating men, all of whom want to marry her.

programme.title: Captain Kidd
programme.desc: Cutthroat pirate William Kidd captures Admiral Blayne's treasure ship and hides the bounty in a cave. Three years later, Kidd, posing as a respectable merchant captain, offers his services to the King of England. Seeking a social position, Kidd also negotiates for Blayne's title and lands, provided he can prove Blayne was associated with piracy. Launched upon his royal mission, Kidd is unaware that Blayne's son Adam is among the crew, determined to clear his father's name.

programme.title: The Man Who Cheated Himself
programme.desc: A veteran homicide detective who has witnessed his socialite girlfriend kill her husband sees his inexperienced brother assigned to the case.

programme.title: Suddenly
programme.desc: The tranquility of a small town is marred only by sheriff Tod Shaw's unsuccessful courtship of widow Ellen Benson, a pacifist who can't abide guns and those who use them. But violence descends on Ellen's household willy-nilly when the U.S. President passes through town... and slightly psycho hired assassin John Baron finds the Benson home ideal for an ambush.

programme.title: A Woman's Life
programme.desc: A woman remember's her own marriage when dealing with the love life of her son.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Ageing, wealthy, rancher and self-made man, George Washington McLintock is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife—who left him two years previously—suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in George; she wants custody of their daughter.

programme.title: Guerrero
programme.desc: In the depths of the Sierra of Guerrero in Mexico, after the disappearance of the 43 students, we find the reaction of wounded civil society to seek an answer to the situation of abuse of authority mixed with poverty.

programme.title: The Strange Woman
programme.desc: In early 19th century New England, an attractive unscrupulous woman uses her beauty and wits to deceive and control the men around her.

programme.title: A Farewell to Arms
programme.desc: A ravishing adaptation of Ernest Hemingway's legendary novel, A FAREWELL TO ARMS stars Gary Cooper as Lt. Frederic Henry, a young ambulance driver for the Italian army in WWI, more interested in chasing women than the enemy. When seeking cover during an air raid, he encounters Nurse Catherine Barkley, and the world shifts under his feet. They fall in love, but the war keeps wrenching them apart. These painful separations force Frederic to choose between love and battle, a decision that tests him morally and spiritually, and leads to one of the most rapturously romantic endings of all time.

programme.title: The Fabulous Dorseys
programme.desc: The rise and rise of the Fabulous Dorsey brothers is charted in this whimsical step down memory lane, Tommy and Jimmy Dorsey play themselves in this vehicle for their excellent music.

programme.title: Doll Face
programme.desc: Burlesque queen Doll Face Carroll is dismissed from an audition for a legitimate Broadway show because she lacks culture. Her boss/manager Mike decides that she can get both culture and plenty of publicity by writing her autobiography. He hires a ghost writer to do all the work, but doesn't count on the possibility that Doll Face and her collaborator might have more than a book on their minds.

programme.title: Career Girl
programme.desc: Joan Terry, a girl from the country wants to become a Broadway Star, but this proves to be not so easy.

programme.title: Daughters, Wives and a Mother
programme.desc: Tashiro coincidentally meets his best friend Sugimoto in a bar very close to the apartment in which Sugimoto's wayward wife is found dead. Although Tashiro is not a suspect in the police investigation, he is racked with guilt and confesses to his wife, Masako. In an effort to further relieve his tortured sense of guilt, he then confesses to Sugimoto. Neither his wife nor his friend can believe that he could have been involved.

programme.title: The Vanishing Pioneer
programme.desc: A mining engineer teams up with a crusty deputy sheriff to solve the mystery killings at an old mine where the owner's family waits for him to die, and where a valuable radium strike may have been made.

programme.title: Girl Gang
programme.desc: A sleazy gangster has a gang of young girls commit robberies and prostitution for him by getting them hooked on drugs.

programme.title: The Jungle Woman
programme.desc: When a treasure hunter seeks a downed airplane in the jungles of Africa, he encounters one of the passenger's young daughter, now fully grown, and with a gorilla protector.

programme.desc: A neurosurgeon with a cheating wife takes an amnesiac into his home and conditions him to believe that the cheating wife is his own and to take the "appropriate" action.

programme.desc: A circus becomes the location for stolen loot and murder.

programme.desc: An unscrupulous private investigator with a penchant for blackmail is found dead in a car and the leading suspect is Janet Bradley, the daughter of a mayoral candidate. With the election just weeks away, shady and ruthless individuals muscle the medical officer into switching the corpse with another body. Lieutenant Sam Carson, one of the few good apples in the bunch must find a way to get to the bottom of it all.

In order to find out about the reason for this accusation and to protest his innocence, he tries to look behind the façade of the judicial system. But since this remains fruitless, there seems to be no chance for him to escape from this nightmare.

programme.desc: Through a fluke circumstance, a ruthless woman stumbles across a suitcase filled with $60,000, and is determined to hold onto it even if it means murder.

Douglas; the election of 1860; his presidency during the Civil War; and his assassination in Ford's Theater in 1865.

programme.title: People Are Funny
programme.desc: A comedy based on NBC's "People Are Funny" radio (and later television) program with Art Linkletter with a fictional story of how the program came to be on a national network from its humble beginning at a Nevada radio station. Jack Haley is a producer with only half-rights to the program while Ozzie Nelson and Helen Walker are the radio writers and supply the romance. Rudy Vallee, always able to burlesque himself intentional and, quite often, unintentional, is the owner of the sought-after sponsoring company. Frances Langford, as herself, sings "I'm in the Mood for Love" while the Vagabonds quartet (billed 12th and last) chimes in on "Angeline" and "The Old Square Dance is Back Again."

programme.desc: A rebellious young inductee has trouble toeing the line until he meets a retired officer's lovely daughter. James and his band are also drafted and decide to perk up their camp by putting on a big show.

programme.desc: Jimmy idolizes bootlegger Matt, and when he refuses to implicate his friend, he is sent to reform school. He befriends Shorty, a boy with a heart condition, and escapes to let the world know about the brutal conditions.

Mr. Wong faces increasing danger and is nearly executed himself as the investigation develops in treachery and complexity. As Mr. Wong follows the trail of dead bodies, he uncovers a jewel smuggling ring on the San Francisco waterfront and a case much larger than the death of a police officer.

programme.desc: Captain Drummond and his girlfriend want to marry but a hidden treasure in the house in which they want to celebrate their marriage is complicating the situation involving a series of deaths and an elusive murderer.

programme.title: Mother
programme.desc: A teenaged girl witnesses her widowed mother's attempt to sustain her family.

Their task is to disrupt England's radar network in preparation for a full scale German invasion. Once the villagers discover the true identity of the troops, they do whatever they can to thwart the Nazis plans.

Brennan/Talbot are twin brothers (one a casino owner, the other a rancher) and Hoppy believes they provide alibis for each other while one is out committing crimes. Hoppy gets a job in the casino to learn more but is exposed when a gambling gunslinger notices him.

programme.desc: This is a wonderful story of a matchmaking event in Italy. Young men and women are escorted to a midsummer dance. There is a man who coordinates the proper arrangements and the mountain villages send their youth.

programme.desc: Seven guests, a newly hired personal secretary and two staff are gathered for a weekend on an isolated island by the hosts the Owens who are delayed. At dinner a record is played and the host's message alleges that all the people present are guilty of murder and suddenly the first of them is dead, then the next _ It seems that one of them is the murderer but the leading person is always the person who is murdered next and at last only two people are left.

The work helps her find her sensitive side in the caring and helping of her young patients. Kelly's path towards happiness is thrown amiss, when she witnesses a shocking event, which threatens not just her happiness, but her mental health as well.

programme.desc: Terrified of being buried alive by mistake, a woman puts a phone in her crypt to be able to call home if she needs help. She dies and nothing happens. One day, the phone suddenly rings. Paranormal investigator Nelson Orion is brought in.

She "covers" the inquest of the death of a woman who was poisoned. Nancy doesn't think the young woman accused of the crime is guilty and corrals her neighbor Ted into searching for a vital piece of evidence and stumbles onto the identity of the real killer.

programme.title: The Phantom of 42nd Street

Director Ewald Andre Dupont took almost a year to make Moulin Rouge at a production cost of $500,000, a huge amount for 1928.

programme.title: The Ambassador to Bern

programme.title: Venčanica iz snova

programme.title: Paklene mačke

programme.title: Paklene mačke
programme.desc: Džekson pomaže veteranu s posttraumatskim sindromom koga nervira njegova mačka za terapiju. Pored toga, Bartolomiu ne samo da uništava nameštaj, već takođe i jedan brak.

programme.title: Paklene mačke
programme.desc: Džekson mora da nađe način da pomogne oko nekontrolisanog obeležavanja teritorije uznemirene mačke. I može li da privoli vlasnika da prestane da hrani svoju mačku dijabetičara?

programme.title: Paklene mačke
programme.desc: Džekson upoznaje mačka siledžiju koja drži sve ženke mačke kao taoce, zbog čega se one kriju u kupatilu. Osim toga, upoznaje mačku za terapije koja volontira u dobrotvorne svrhe.

programme.desc: Interna priča o kontraverznom poljupcu između Luisa Rubijalesa i španske zvezde Dženi Ermoso, koju su ispričali njeni saigrači i bliski prijatelji.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Canned food began with Napoleon's contest to preserve food, won by Appert's boiled, sealed bottles. The British later developed metal cans, though early ones exploded or caused illness. Can openers came 30 years later. Pasteur's germ theory explained spoilage. Pressure-cooking improved taste, and now, 'raddaperization'—zapping food—is the future. Canning evolved from battlefield necessity to high-tech preservation.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Every single day there is a growing number of people to feed and in the next thirty to forty years we will need to double our food production to sustain the increase in population. In this episode author Julian Cribb examines the infestations that are threatening our food supply.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: Long-hidden secrets are revealed through the R.I.P. team's talents and unique experiences, including those thought to be lost forever.

programme.title: What In the World
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: In this episode, we focus on geological disasters beyond earthquakes and volcanoes—avalanches, landslides, blizzards, heatwaves, and sinkholes. While they may seem less deadly, they can cause immense misery. Heatwaves, for example, are silent killers; one in India melted roads at 45°C for two weeks. From landslides to blizzards, these events remind us that Earth's smaller disturbances can be as dangerous as major cataclysms.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ _ experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ _ experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray takes the Great Ocean Road along the Antarctic facing coast of Australia _ the longest South facing coastline in the world. He starts in Port Philp Bay the entrance to Melbourne Harbour where for the first time he sees a strange marine creature _ the weedy sea dragon _ a relative of the sea horse. He also swims with a unique species of dolphin _ the Burrunan Dolphins.Crossing the Bay he heads off down the longest War Memorial in the world _ the Great Ocean Road and meets 93 year old Doug Stirling who remembers the world war 1 veterans building the road.Ray visits the Penguin Colony on Middle Island where guard dogs protect the penguins from foxes and he watches the night time return of the penguins after a day spent at sea fishing.He takes to the seas and discovers the creatures of the deep waters _ albatross, balls of krill and a pod of fast moving common dolphins.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray explores the Red Centre of the country and shows that the Australian desert is filled with life for those who know where to find water.He arrives in the Red Centre by chopper as he flies over the Uluru monolith or Ayres Rock. For his first stop, he goes to a red kangaroo sanctuary where he cuddles a joey, meets their carer Brolga and gets close to the usually wary adult red kangaroos. He pursues his journey deeper in the desert to meet a local aboriginal Sammy Wilson. They go to a traditional waterhole and chat over a camp fire about Sammy's ancestral knowledge of the land. Ray spends the night out under the stars before driving more inland to rocky areas where water collects. There Ray comes face to face with a wild kangaroo and rock wallabies. He then follows tracks along a dry river bed that lead him to Australia's wild dog: a dingo.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Dali the emperor tamarin is mysteriously going bald—on his back! Keepers suspect two mischievous monkey roommates. Meanwhile, Kristina attempts an eye ultrasound on dolphin Ulysses, needing patience and precision. And it's party time for Garoe the chimp, who celebrates his first birthday with a swinging cake surprise!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with _ especially on her Segway! And with a normal day including alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods _ you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too! When Loro Parque and their volunteers conduct one of their famous beach clean ups _ you won't believe what they unearth! Even better though, a turtle rescued last year with a fishing hook in its throat is being released back to its ocean home. Now that's a good day at the beach.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures

This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Radar accurate eyes survey the land, slotted feathers adjust flight paths as falcons attack, pelicans soar, kestrels hover, owls silently fly, parrots flock, vultures swarm and eagles swoop. Which is the true Master of the Sky? Peregrine Falcon _ Revered for speed and power, this raptor was favored by ancient falconers. Budgie _ Bright green and yellow budgies light up Australia's skies in lively flocks. Wedge-tailed Eagle _ Australia's largest bird of prey commands awe with its soaring presence. Pelican _ Graceful giants of the sky, pelicans glide in formation on rising thermals. Seabirds _ Nearly 300 species live between sea and air, truly free in their vast domain. Barn Owl _ Mysterious and wise, the barn owl watches silently from the shadows. Vulture _ Africa's plains are scanned by vultures, nature's cleanup crew. Nankeen Kestrel _ Australia's smallest falcon, elegant and inquisitive, glides over open land.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The colossal elephant. The lush tropical forests of Asia hold within them some of nature's mightiest creatures.Each of these silent footsteps carries with it the immense weight of the world's largest land mammal. The intimidating birds with soaring grace and aerial prowess, birds dominate our skies. To remain the undisputed pioneers of the air most bird species are feather light and relatively small. The barrel-like Hippo Lumbering across land, the enormity of the barrel like hippo is without question. Other grass eaters are frail by comparison. The towering giraffe standing taller than any other living animal in their towering majesty is the proud and elegant giraffe. The gigantic whale the Mighty whale graces our oceans with a size and strength unrivalled on land. Three times longer than the tallest giraffe and weighing more than a dozen hippos' the beautiful humpback whale is most famed for its mystical and haunting song. Which is the biggest of them all?

programme.title: The Blue Realm
programme.desc: Another rare species and close relative of manatees is the dugong. Dugongs cling to survival in a few isolated corners of the globe. In marine sanctuaries in Abu Dhabi, the bizarre animals have been notoriously difficult to find, let alone photograph. Manatees and Dugongs features exclusive HD imagery of the mammals in the wild and examines efforts of scientists to protect the two species. The program also includes thrilling captures and field exams of manatees in Florida.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Finally for this series, we are exploring the world of nocturnal animals—creatures adapted to thrive in darkness. Escaping predators, avoiding heat, and sharing resources, they emerge as night falls. Join porcupines, raccoons, mice, cats, foxes, and more on their nightly journey. From raccoons with sensitive touch to mice surviving in teams, each is a master of the night. Across continents, these animals—like the fruit-loving porcupine—showcase fear, excitement, and survival in the shadows.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: There are many fine examples of evolutionary history in the natural world. Animals evolve through small mutations to better compete for resources. Crocodiles, over 200 million years old, survived extinction due to their adaptability—slow metabolism, 4-chamber heart, and lungs that allow 2-hour dives. Sharks retained successful traits from ancient ancestors, evolving gradually. Whales transitioned from land to sea, developing echolocation, blubber, modified lungs, and enhanced hearing for survival.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: The Antonov Dream
programme.desc: In the series pilot, host Jonathan Bird travels to the Bahamas, where diver interactions with Tiger sharks have become up close and personal. These large and dangerous animals are not only being hand-fed, but actually handled by divers. Jonathan learns how to flip a Tiger shark from experienced shark handlers. Next, Jonathan investigates the Crystal Cave of Abaco, Bahamas…considered the most highly-ornamented underwater cave in the world!

programme.title: The Antonov Dream
programme.desc: Jonathan travels to Iceland to investigate a giant crack in the ground filled with frigid runoff from melting glaciers. It's rumored to be the clearest water in the world. Next, he heads down to sunny Florida, not to dive a coral reef or a spectacular shipwreck, but to dive in shallow, murky water under a busy bridge. This secret spot is home to some of the ocean's most remarkable, and weird, animals.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Paper wasn't always easy to make or use. Early writing appeared on cave walls, bamboo, and papyrus. True paper was credited to Cai Lun in 105 AD. It was once expensive, but after the Black Death, cloth scraps made it cheaper. Pens evolved too—from messy feathers to the ballpoint. Today, paper contributes heavily to pollution—about 10% of greenhouse gases. The future? E-paper: the digital alternative to traditional paper.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Radio waves, born from electromagnetism, power wireless tech like phones, TVs, and RADAR. Though invisible, they've transformed society. Discoveries by Galvani, Franklin, and Oersted revealed their power. From melting chocolate to X-rays, EM waves penetrate everything—even the human body. Now, they're helping us explore the brain. What's next for this invisible force?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Learn how almond nuts get transformed into "milk." And why are movie trailers shown at the beginning of the film? We'll keep your attention so you'll want to stick around for the answer. And learn how detergents make your clothes seem brighter and whiter.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Learn how a pharmacist and an accountant created the most famous drink in the world, coca cola! And, learn the "Bear" truth behind how a U.S. president helped create everyone's favorite stuffed toy, The Teddy Bear! Then, how did a piece of wire accidentally "Slink" its way to become a fantastic fun toy for children? Plus, how a the wiffle ball was invented.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer closer at nearby stars with ever more fidelity they are discovering planets; exo planets, worlds outside our own solar system. With technological advances and improved techniques scientists are discovering more and more worlds every day. With confidence scientists now calculated there could be as many as 40 billion Earth like planets in our Milky Way galaxy alone.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe the further back in time we reach. What we see in the night sky is only a small percentage of the contents of the Universe, most is dark matter and dark energy we know it exists; however its nature eludes us for the moment.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Vear is when visuals trigger imagined sounds, like the silent thud in the jumping pylon illusion. Retinal fatigue causes afterimages after staring at one color too long. The Müller-Lyer illusion tricks us into seeing equal lines as different lengths due to arrowheads. The Ames Room distorts size perception through skewed architecture. Synesthesia links senses—some people see colors when hearing sounds due to hyperconnected neurons.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Chromatic adaptation lets humans perceive consistent colors despite changing light. Some animals change color using chromatophores—for camouflage or signaling. Pink isn't a real wavelength; our brains create it by blending light. Blue is rare in nature but appears through structural features in feathers and wings. Snow camouflage helps animals blend into winter landscapes using shades of white and gray.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: The team explores St. Albans, a former sanitarium, and captures several shocking EVPs (spirit voices), including the one that became the title of this episode.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray takes the Great Ocean Road along the Antarctic facing coast of Australia _ the longest South facing coastline in the world. He starts in Port Philp Bay the entrance to Melbourne Harbour where for the first time he sees a strange marine creature _ the weedy sea dragon _ a relative of the sea horse. He also swims with a unique species of dolphin _ the Burrunan Dolphins.Crossing the Bay he heads off down the longest War Memorial in the world _ the Great Ocean Road and meets 93 year old Doug Stirling who remembers the world war 1 veterans building the road.Ray visits the Penguin Colony on Middle Island where guard dogs protect the penguins from foxes and he watches the night time return of the penguins after a day spent at sea fishing.He takes to the seas and discovers the creatures of the deep waters _ albatross, balls of krill and a pod of fast moving common dolphins.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray explores the Red Centre of the country and shows that the Australian desert is filled with life for those who know where to find water.He arrives in the Red Centre by chopper as he flies over the Uluru monolith or Ayres Rock. For his first stop, he goes to a red kangaroo sanctuary where he cuddles a joey, meets their carer Brolga and gets close to the usually wary adult red kangaroos. He pursues his journey deeper in the desert to meet a local aboriginal Sammy Wilson. They go to a traditional waterhole and chat over a camp fire about Sammy's ancestral knowledge of the land. Ray spends the night out under the stars before driving more inland to rocky areas where water collects. There Ray comes face to face with a wild kangaroo and rock wallabies. He then follows tracks along a dry river bed that lead him to Australia's wild dog: a dingo.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Loro Parque, voted "World's Best Zoo" two years in a row, blends top-tier animal care with global conservation efforts. From thousands of species to multi-million-dollar research, its mission is clear: protect wildlife and inspire change. What began 45 years ago as one man's passion is now a global model of excellence in education, sustainability, and animal welfare.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Federica the turtle has arrived from Italy after a run in with a container ship. Loro Parque's offered to be her 'forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? You've heard of a fish out of water _ try a turtle!Esmeralda the iguana has a lumpy belly and Jorge the vet is worried. He's hoping it's a bounty of eggs but knows he shouldn't count his iguanas before they hatch. Its fingers crossed for some scaly babies!

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Some animals will never be inconspicuous, others blend so perfectly with their surroundings that they can move through them without detection. Camouflaged cats _ for many of the cats of Africa, camouflage is key to survival. From the spots of the cheetah, the rosettes of the leopard and the stripes and dots of the serval, these cats have evolved to merge with their habitat. Hidden Lizards _ Regal horned lizards vanish into Arizona's deserts, feeding mostly on ants. Cryptic Snakes _ Australia's death adder and carpet python hide in plain sight. Cuttlefish _ Change color, shape, and texture to disappear instantly. Chameleons _ Over 100 species, masters of rainforest disguise. Ptarmigans _ Snow-white birds of the frozen north. Crab Spiders _ Tiny hunters, perfectly matched to bark, leaves, or flowers.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The most venomous snake on land. The deserted heart of the Australian outback, where people seldom venture, is the hot, baked home of the most venomous land snake in the world _ the inland taipan, a two meter long snake with enough venom in one bite to kill a quarter of a million mice. Gila Monster _ North America's largest land lizard, venomous and striking, lives in desert regions. Blue-Ringed Octopus _ Tiny but deadly, it carries two venoms—one lethal to humans. Red-Back Spider _ Hidden in messy webs, the female's scarlet stripe warns of her deadly bite. Sydney Funnel-Web _ Aggressive and armed with toxic venom, the male is especially dangerous. Which venomous creature is the deadliest?

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: They're beautiful _ and deadly, with venomous spines that resemble a lion's mane. They're lionfish, a tropical reef species normally found in the Indo-Pacific. Now, they're wreaking havoc in the Caribbean and Atlantic _ all thought to have descended from a handful of aquarium fish carelessly released into the sea. In these regions, they are potentially a greater threat to coral reefs and commercial fish populations than global warming or pollution. In the Florida Keys, some practical and novel approaches are making progress in the fight against these Toxic Invaders.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: There are many fine examples of evolutionary history in the natural world. Animals evolve through small mutations to better compete for resources. Crocodiles, over 200 million years old, survived extinction due to their adaptability—slow metabolism, 4-chamber heart, and lungs that allow 2-hour dives. Sharks retained successful traits from ancient ancestors, evolving gradually. Whales transitioned from land to sea, developing echolocation, blubber, modified lungs, and enhanced hearing for survival.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Deserts are dry, extreme places with little rain and few plants. Semi-deserts support more life, but survival is still tough. Animals adapt to heat and water scarcity—some drink rarely, get moisture from food, or travel far for water. Many seek shade, burrow, or are nocturnal. Scorpions, ancient and armored, use pincers and venom to survive. Rattlesnakes, fast and deadly, are feared—except by roadrunners, who hunt them. Desert life demands resilience, cleverness, and unique adaptations

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: The Antonov Dream
programme.desc: Cave diving is the most difficult and dangerous type of diving, so the training to become a certified cave diver is arduous. This episode documents Jonathan's actual cave training in the Bahamas and follows him as he learns how to dive safely in the overhead environment of a cave in an attempt to earn his full cave diver certification.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Gunpowder, likely discovered by accident, dates back to 300 AD in China. Made from sulfur, charcoal, and saltpeter—found on aged waste—it was hard to produce but vital for rulers. Its explosive power comes from fast-burning gases. Early gunpowder created thick smoke until Nobel invented smokeless ballistite in 1888. The bacteria behind saltpeter's potency were only understood centuries later. Now, gunpowder may soon be replaced—what's next?

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Humans have long dreamed of flight—from da Vinci's flapping-wing designs to massive cow-gut-filled airships. The Wright brothers, inspired by bicycles, built strong, controllable kites that led to early planes. Modern jets fly faster thanks to high-altitude, low-resistance flight, an idea sparked by Frank Whittle's Aeolipile experiments. From the Airbus A380 to NASA's scramjet, aviation keeps evolving—what's next in flight innovation?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Before computer drawing programs, there was a toy that if you mastered its two circular white knobs you could have a picture perfect sketch. programme.desc: The Monty Hall Problem shows switching choices boosts winning odds. The Birthday Problem reveals how just 23 people can have a 50% chance of shared birthdays due to multiple pairings. Gambler's Ruin proves that in a fair game, the smaller bankroll loses over time. The Infinite Hotel Paradox explores the strange logic of infinity. The Locker Riddle uses factorization to reveal why only lockers with perfect square numbers stay open.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Carrion flowers like rafflesia arnoldii are rare, large, and foul-smelling, attracting flies for pollination. Pheromones are chemical signals used for mating, tracking, or alarms. Deimatic behavior startles predators with sudden displays, helping prey escape

programme.title: Primož Dolničar: Blago iz tegle

programme.title: Patina meksička jela

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Činjenica je da Bugari vole svinjetinu, ali Lora i Stojan je prosto obožavaju. Zato će podeliti recept za svinjetinu sa mirisnom korom i prilogom. Spremiće i neverovatnu kupus-salatu i za kraj, dezert koji se zove "Dunavski talasi".

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Salata od spelte i spanaća, koju spremaju Lora i Stojan, toliko je zasitna da može da služi i za laganu večeru. Mesne kuglice u belom umaku iz starih dana biće servirane kao savremeno i neodoljivo jelo.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Recepti za čorbe od pasulja uvek su dobrodošle. Stojan i Lora su odlučili da podele tradicionalan recept Stojanove porodice, sa carskim mesom, mnogo povrća i mirisnim divljim kimom. Sve će biti propraćeno ukusnim hlebom sa susamom.

programme.title: Prijatno

programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Projekat Dinosaur
programme.desc: Projekat "Dinosaurus" govori o ekspediciji oca i sina u Kongu, uz pratnju dokumentarističke TV ekipe. Kad svi akteri filma misteriozno nestanu, pronađeni snimak pokazaće zapanjujuće snimke dinosaurusa, za koje se verovalo da su izumrli pre 65 miliona godina.

programme.title: Crveno nebo
programme.desc: Osramoćeni "top gan" pilot, Buč Masters, predvodi odmetnuti vod koji mora da povrati kataklizmičko oružje za masovno uništenje. Kad otkrije da njegov bivši partner, Tom Kreg, radi za teroriste, Masters se mora izboriti s uništenim prijateljstvom i ljubavnim trouglom, ali i upustiti u vazdušnu bitku, kako bi povratio vojničku i ličnu čast.

programme.title: Pirati sa Velikog Slanog Jezera
programme.desc: Kirk Redgrejv je sanjar koji živi s majkom, sve dok njegovo tajno piratsko životarenje ne bude otkriveno i primora ga na selidbu. Sa sobom vodi simpatičnog Flinta i zajedno kreću na Veliko slano jezero, praveći haos među slučajnim turistima i amaterskim mornarima. Kada naiđu na pravu mapu ukletog blaga, počinje luda potraga u kojoj ih prate čudni likovi takođe u lovu na bogatstvo. Ovo je zabavna i neobična priča o prijateljstvu i najluđim fantazijama dvojice ekscentrika.

programme.title: Peščani čovek
programme.desc: Jednog jutra, Beno pronalazi pesak u svom krevetu. Iako u početku pokušava ovo da ignoriše, ubrzo shvata da taj pesak ispada iz njega. Iz dana u dan, količina peska je sve veća i njegovo vreme ubrzano ističe. Na kraju nema izbora i pomoć traži od Sandre, vlasnice omanjeg kafea ispod njegovog stana. Iako je Beno strastveno mrzi, počinje da je sanja svake noći. Kakva je veza između Sandre, snova i peska?

programme.title: Pas Timber - Lovac na blago
programme.desc: Dečak i njegov najbolji prijatelj (preslatki pas koji govori), daju sve od sebe da sačuvaju svoj dom i porodicu.

programme.title: Ujak Nino
programme.desc: Otuđena i prilično disfunkcionalna porodica ponovo se zbližava, kada im iz Italije u Čikago u iznenadnu posetu dođe očev davno izgubljeni ujak Nino.

programme.title: Mister Olimpija
programme.desc: Inspirativna priča o začetnicima fitnesa kakvog danas poznajemo, Džou i Benu Vajderu. Suočeni s antisemitizmom i velikim siromaštvom, braća su savladala sve prepreke, izgradila imperiju i inspirisala buduće generacije.

programme.title: Reči
programme.desc: Mladi pisac Rori Jansen koji je na vrhuncu svog književnog uspeha, otkriva visoku cenu koju mora da plati za krađu tuđeg dela.

programme.title: Vidimo se u septembru
programme.desc: "Vidimo se u septembru" je originalna romantična komedija, smeštena u moderni Menhetn. Film govori o Lizi, prelepoj ženi koja naizgled ima sve, ali se duboko u sebi plaši vezivanja. Kad sazna da će njen terapeut celog avgusta biti na odmoru, šokirana je i uplašena. Umesto da ovu vest prihvati smireno, ona traži pomoć od ogorčene prijateljice, Monike.

programme.title: Henrijev zločin
programme.desc: Čovek bez ikakvog cilja u životu, poslat je u zatvor na izdržavanje kazne za zločin koji nije počinio.

programme.title: Gospođica niko i ništa
programme.desc: Sarah Jane je nesrećna u ljubavi, živi sa svojom ekscentričnom majkom i radi u firmi Judge Pharmaceuticals kao sekretarica bez ikakve perspektive za unapredjenje. Iznenadno unapredjenje na menadžersko mesto _ izgleda je to šta je tražila. Ipak zajedno s unapredjenjem pojavljuje se novi svet, pun konkurencije od strane drugih poslovodja,koji je pun spletaka i mnogo komplikovan. Sara počinje da eliminiše konkurenciju na jedini način koji zna … ubija. Na putu ka vrhu upoznaje iznenada muškarca svojih snova _ detektiva Billa Malloya, koji namerava da otkrije tajne smrti u Judge Pharmaceuticals.

programme.title: Tamnice i zmajevi 3: Knjiga podle tame
programme.desc: "Treći deo sage "Tamnice i zmajevi". Ekranizacija poznate kompjuterske igre. Paladin Grejson želeo je da postane plemeniti vitez. Nakon krvave bitke u kojoj gine njegov otac, a Grejson kao jedini preživljava, pristupa grupi čarobnjaka-ratnika. Principi kojih se drži daleki su od viteških ideala. Ipak, samo zahvaljujući tom savezu mladić može da dosegne svoj cilj _ da pronađe oca, živog ili mrtvog.

programme.title: Slom
programme.desc: Policajka se sa ćerkom vraća u rodni grad da brine o teško bolesnoj majci. Međutim, ubistvo mlade sugrađanke otvara istragu koju zapravo niko ne želi da vodi, pa ona ostaje duže nego što je planirala kako bi otkrila istinu.

programme.title: Slom
programme.desc: Policajka se sa ćerkom vraća u rodni grad da brine o teško bolesnoj majci. Međutim, ubistvo mlade sugrađanke otvara istragu koju zapravo niko ne želi da vodi, pa ona ostaje duže nego što je planirala kako bi otkrila istinu.

programme.title: Adam
programme.desc: Požrtvovani službenik hipotekarne banke postaje kvadriplegičar nakon nesreće.

programme.title: Opoziv
programme.desc: Veliki Vesli Snajps igra lovca u ovom SF ostvarenju. Petoro prijatelja odlazi na odmor u kućici na jezeru, očekujući miran vikend. Ipak, ne znaju da je Zemlja pod opsadom vanzemaljaca i da su masovne otmice u toku, što njihovu avanturu pretvara u borbu za opstanak.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Operacija "Panda"
programme.desc: Međunarodna akciona zvezda Džeki Čen pozvan je na ceremoniju usvajanja retke bebe pande. Ali kada međunarodni kriminalni sindikat pokuša da otme mladunče, Džeki mora da ga spase oslanjajući se na svoje veštine i vratolomije koje su neizbežne u njegovim borilačkim filmovima.

programme.title: Penina senka
programme.desc: Tokom odmora na ostrvu Ejmland, devojka otkriva opasnog konja koji nema poverenja u ljude. Da bi dokazala da konj uopšte nije opasan, devojka ga potajno obučava kako bi ponovo stekao poverenje u ljude.

programme.title: Intergalaktičke avanture Maksa Klauda
programme.desc: Svemirska krstarica pada na ljubičastu planetu Hinus, intergalaktički zatvor u kom borave najopasniji i najveći zločinci u galaksiji.

programme.title: Okršaj
programme.desc: Sedamnaestogodišnji učenik, koji je čitavog života izbegavao da pokaže zube, prinuđen je da se konačno izbori za sebe, svoju porodicu i svoju budućnost u dirljivoj priči o identitetu i odrastanju.

programme.title: Strašna strana istorije: Pokvareni Rimljani
programme.desc: Mladi Rimljanin Ati primoran je da se pridruži rimskoj vojsci kada jedna od njegovih "lukavih smicalica" zasmeta lično Neronu. Šalju ga u "bednu, hladnu i vlažnu Britaniju", čiji se stanovnici bune. Stvari postaju još gore kad Atija zarobi Orla, opasna mlada Keltkinja koja gori od želje da se dokaže kao ratnica. Nakon što je za dlaku izbegao vrlo gadan kraj u močvari, Ati koristi znanje stečeno u Rimu kako bi pomogao Orli da spase svoju baku, koju je kidnapovalo suparničko pleme. U međuvremenu, besni Neron odlučuje da uguši pobunu koju predvodi Budika, kraljica Icenija. Ati se ponovo pridružuje rimskim trupama i otkriva da se spremaju za istorijski obračun sa Keltima u bici kod Votling strita. Ati bi mogao sve da zaustavi, ali i da dovede do katastrofe za Orlu, jer se dvoje novopečenih prijatelja sada nalaze na suprotnim stranama bojnog polja.

programme.title: Mala sirena
programme.desc: Mladi novinar i njegova sestričina otkrivaju prelepo i očaravajuće stvorenje za koje veruju da je prava mala sirena.

programme.title: Kuvar
programme.desc: Nakon što izgubi posao u restoranu, talentovani kuvar počinje da prodaje hranu iz kamioneta, tražeći sve vreme kreativnost i izgubljenu strast prema kuvanju. Putovanje ga vodi kroz nove gradove, ali i ka ponovnom zbližavanju sa porodicom od koje se udaljio.

programme.title: Krvoproliće
programme.desc: Priča o srdačnom susretu četvoro roditelja, nakon tuče u školskom dvorištu između njihovih sinova.

programme.title: Svi putevi vode u Rim
programme.desc: Megi je samohrana majka i fakultetska profesorka iz Njujorka. U pokušaju da pronađe zajednički jezik sa Samer, njenom ćerkom tinejdžerkom, Megi odlazi u selo u Toskani, gde je kao mlada provela mnogo vremena. Odmah po dolasku Megi nailazi na Luku, zgodnog bivšeg momka koji je i dalje neženja i živi sa svojom osamdesetogodišnjom majkom, Karmen. Samer, kojoj nedostaje žestoki momak iz Njujorka, zajedno s Karmen, koja uprkos Lukinom protivljenju planira da se uda za Marselina, njenu jedinu pravu ljubav, impulsivno kradu Luki kola i beže u Rim. Megi i Luka kreću u poteru za njima.

programme.title: Dnevnik Bridžet Džouns
programme.desc: Na startu Nove godine, 32-godišnja Bridžet odlučuje da preuzme kontrolu nad svojim životom i počinje da vodi dnevnik. Ubrzo se nađe rastrzana između šarmantnog Danijela i ozbiljnog Marka, dok posao i prijatelji dodatno komplikuju njen haotični svet.

programme.title: Bridžet Džouns na ivici razuma
programme.desc: Četiri nedelje od početka njene nove veze, Bridžet počinje da sumnja u Marka. Osim što otkriva da glasa za konzervativce, suočava se s novim šefom, čudnim saradnikom i najgorim odmorom u životu.

programme.title: Beba Bridžet Džouns
programme.desc: Nakon raskida s Markom Darsijem, Bridžet, ponovo sama i u svojim četrdesetim, posvećuje se poslu i prijateljima, uverena da sve drži pod kontrolom. A onda upoznaje šarmantnog Amerikanca Džeka i ostaje trudna. Problem je u tome što nije sigurna ko bi mogao biti otac.

programme.title: Beba Bridžet Džouns
programme.desc: Nakon raskida s Markom Darsijem, Bridžet, ponovo sama i u svojim četrdesetim, posvećuje se poslu i prijateljima, uverena da sve drži pod kontrolom. A onda upoznaje šarmantnog Amerikanca Džeka i ostaje trudna. Problem je u tome što nije sigurna ko bi mogao biti otac.

programme.title: Bridžet Džouns: Luda za njim
programme.desc: Bridžet kao udovica i samohrana majka uz pomoć porodice, prijatelja i bivšeg ljubavnika Danijela pokušava da pronađe balans. Vraća se poslu i dejting aplikacijama, gde je privlači mlađi muškarac, koji je sasvim slučajno i učitelj njenog sina.

programme.title: Smrtna kazna
programme.desc: Nik Hjum je povučen čovek, izvršni direktor sa savršenim životom, koji jedne večeri postaje svedok događaja koji ga zauvek menja. Ophrvan tugom, Hjum dolazi do uznemirujućeg zaključka da ne postoji granica koju neće preći kako bi zaštitio svoju porodicu.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Deca bez granica
programme.desc: Ešton, Selest i Beka su troje neobičnih srednjoškolskih otpadnika koji formiraju klub u napuštenom pozorištu. Tamo upoznaju Čarlija (Bil Kobs), beskućnika koji deli njihovu ljubav prema muzičkom pozorištu. Kad saznaju za plan da se pozorište sruši, tinejdžeri pokušavaju da ga spasu modernom izvedbom Šekspirovog komada "Mnogo buke ni oko čega". Tokom pripreme predstave, deca uče da se prema drugima odnose s poštovanjem i da se bore za svoja uverenja. U filmu igra i Li Meriveder, nominovana za Zlatni globus.

programme.title: Restoran
programme.desc: Ova zabavna i topla dramedija smeštena je unutar uzbudljive kulinarske scene San Franciska. Priča prati Sala Sartinija, radišnog kuvara, koji mora pronaći način da ponovo raspali svoju ljubav prema kuvanju, ali i da popravi odnose sa svojim sinom, pre nego što još jednom sve stavi na kocku.

programme.title: Kung-fu kaskader
programme.desc: Propali kaskader i njegov konj preko noći postaju senzacija na društvenim mrežama kada njihov stvarni obračun s uterivačima dugova postane viralan.

programme.title: Tajna zmajevog pečata
programme.desc: Engleski putnik Džonatan Grin dobija od Petra Velikog nalog da mapira ruski Daleki istok. Još jednom kreće na dugo putovanje ispunjeno neverovatnim avanturama koje će ga konačno odvesti do Kine. Kartograf će neočekivano naići na mnoštvo izvanrednih otkrića, susresti bizarna stvorenja, upoznati se s kineskim princezama i suočiti sa opasnim majstorima borilačkih veština, pa čak i sa kraljem svih zmajeva.

programme.title: Prvi pas
programme.desc: Usvojeni dečak se sprijatelji s izgubljenim psom za koga se ispostavlja da pripada predsedniku Sjedinjenih Država. On odluči da pobegne od kuće i vrati psa u Belu kuću, jer je to po njemu jedino ispravno.

programme.title: Zaboravljeni
programme.desc: Džordž je mentalno oboleli beskućnik, koji već godinama nije u stanju da sačuva radno mesto. On luta gradom tražeći hranu, alkohol i sklonište, ali sve vreme pokušava da ostvari kontakt sa svojom ćerkom. Džordž se obraća njujorškoj socijalnoj službi, ali mu za potrebnu finansijsku pomoć nedostaju dokumenta. Tada postaje prijatelj s drugim beskućnikom, koji tvrdi da je bio uspešni džez muzičar.

programme.title: Dve karte za Mars
programme.desc: Glavni protagonista traži pomoć osiguravajuće kuće kako bi isplanirao put u jednom pravcu za Mars.

programme.title: Dženino venčanje
programme.desc: U gradiću u kom je rođena, niko ne shvata zašto se Dženi, najlepša i najpopularnija devojka iz kraja, još uvek nije udala. Kruže glasine da je ljubavnica oženjenog muškarca u "velikom gradu" u kom sada živi, zbog čega nikoga ne dovodi sa sobom na venčanje svog školskog druga. Njeni roditelji očajnički žele da se skrasi. Ipak, Dženina objava venčanja, kada do toga konačno dođe, nije ono što je bilo ko od njih očekivao.

programme.title: Isterivači duhova
programme.desc: Nakon invazije duhova na Menhetn, ljubiteljke paranormalnih pojava Erin Gilbert i Ejbi Jejts, nuklearna inženjerka Džilijan Holcman i radnica podzemne železnice, Peti Tolan, zajedno se suprotstavljaju neprijatelju s drugog sveta.

programme.title: Đavolje trojstvo
programme.desc: U burnoj Montani 1870-ih, osuđenik Ajzak Brodvej pred pogubljenje poverava otuđenom sinu Henriju nemoguć zadatak: da ubije čoveka koji ga je lažno optužio. Henrijeva potraga vodi ga u zabačeni grad Triniti, gde se zatiče između pravednog šerifa Gabrijela Dava i tajanstvenog stranca po imenu Sent Kristofer.

programme.title: Iskupljenje
programme.desc: Ostareli bivši bokser i gangster, koji radi kao batinaš za bostonskog mafijaša, dobija tešku dijagnozu. Dok mu pamćenje polako vene, on pokušava da ispravi grehe prošlosti i obnovi vezu s decom, odlučan da ostavi nešto dobro svom unuku. Ipak, podzemlje nikoga ne pušta tako lako iz svojih kandži.

programme.title: Ljubav i seks
programme.desc: Hiljade načina da se voli Južna Koreja je zemlja sa najnižom stopom nataliteta na svetu, a procenjuje se da će se njen broj stanovnika do kraja ovog veka prepoloviti. Uzrok tome je izuzetno konkurentno društvo opsednuto profesionalnim uspehom. Zbog toga je 75 odsto muškaraca i 68 odsto žena između 20 i 44 godine bez partnera. Pošto nije lako pronaći srodnu dušu, Južnokorejci su postali među najvećim korisnicima estetske hirurgije na svetu, a agencije za sklapanje brakova veoma su rasprostranjene. Suočeni sa takvim pritiscima i ograničenjima, mnogi odustaju: nema ljubavi, braka ni dece. Za ovu generaciju život može biti uspešan i na druge načine. Seks se, zauzvrat, čini kao manje komplikovana razonoda od ljubavi.

programme.title: Zemlja meda
programme.desc: Ušuškana u izolovanom planinskom regionu duboko usred Balkana, Hatidže Muratova živi sa svojom bolesnom majkom u selu bez puteva, struje i tekuće vode. Ona je poslednja u dugoj liniji divljih pčelara koja vrca domaći med u malim količinama i prodaje ga u najbližem gradu, udaljenom neka četiri sata hoda. Hatidžin mirni život je bačen u vrtlog dolakom nomadske porodice, sa njihovim glasnim motorima, sedmoro nemirne dece i krdom stoke. Hatidže optimistično prihvata obećanje promene otvorenog srca, ali neće biti potrebno mnogo da sukob rasvetli temeljne tenzije između prirode i čovečanstva, sklada i nesklada, eksploatacije i održivosti. Debitantski dugometražni film dokumentarista Ljubomira Stefanova i Tamare Kotevske, "Zemlja meda" prikazuje nam epski kvalitet širokih kadrova, ali jasno se zasniva na intimnoj saradnji između filmadžija i subjekta filma. Uz iznenađujući smisao za humor, ovo je težak i nežan portret osetljive ravnoteže između ljudi i prirode, mali uvid u način života koji je pred nestankom i nezaboravno svedočenje o otpornosti jedne izvanredne žene.

programme.title: Diktator: Razgovori o Hitleru
programme.desc: Sve od smrti Adolfa Hitlera pre 80 godina u bunkeru u Berlinu pa do danas ne prestaje potraga za istinom o čoveku koji stoji iza najstrašnijih zločina u istoriji. Pronađeni su, intervjuisani i ispitani svi koji su ikada sreli ili poznavali Hitlera. Zaključani u arhivima širom Evrope, Rusije, Amerike i drugih delova sveta, čuvaju se na hiljade sati snimljenih razgovora sa Hitlerovim najbližim prijateljima, saradnicima i pomagačima. Neki od tih intervjua nikada nisu emitovani, a mnogi nisu čuti generacijama. Sada, po prvi put na televiziji, objedinjujemo ta svedočenja kako bismo stvorili jedinstven portret Adolfa Hitlera i bacili novo svetlo na to ko je bio i kako je koristio svoju moć. Ovo je Hitler kakvog do sada nismo videli _ ne čovek nesposoban za međuljudske odnose, već čovek čiji je uspeh zavisio upravo od podrške i odanosti uskog kruga bliskih prijatelja. Mnogi Hitlerovi prijatelji bili su nacisti. Neki su bili osuđeni za ratne zločine. Malobrojnima se može verovati. Ali ako Adolfa Hitlera sagledamo njihovim očima, otkrićemo ko je on zaista bio i šta je omogućilo njegov uspon.

programme.title: Naučne minijature
programme.desc: "Naučne minijature" je zabavna i intrigantna naučna serija koja testira znanje gledalaca o različitim naučnim temama. Privlači gledaoce iznenađujućim činjenicama, brzim kvizovima i zanimljivim mišljenjima. "Naučne minijature" koristi šest stručnjaka koji nas vode kroz različite oblasti kao što su životinje, svemir i planete.

programme.title: U mobilnim telefonima predsednika država
programme.desc: Od Pariza do Vašingtona, od Pjongjanga do Tel Aviva, pametni telefon je promenio pravila politike i postao najvažnije sredstvo svetskih lidera. Međutim, iako je postao njihov omiljeni način komunikacije, može biti i njihov najveći neprijatelj. Ono što je nekada bilo simbol tehnološkog napretka danas je postalo oružje sposobno da preko noći izazove međunarodne krize. Ovaj mali uređaj sa ekranom osetljivim na dodir pokretačka je snaga razvoja vlasti u digitalnom dobu: komunikacija je postala neposrednija, moć ranjivija, a opasnost neuporedivo veća.

programme.title: Nevolje s Kanjeom
programme.desc: Film "Nevolje s Kanjeom" istražuje uspone i padove u životu i karijeri Kanjea Vesta, poznatog i kao Je. U oktobru 2022. godine, Je, ranije poznat kao Kanje Vest, bio je meta opšte osude nakon što je nosio majicu s natpisom "Životi belaca su bitni" na Pariskoj nedelji mode. Nakon ove kontroverze je usledio i niz antisemitskih izjava na društvenim mrežama. Pošto su njegove sporne izjave dospele u naslove novina širom sveta, Je je nastavio da deli opasne i zapaljive neistine tokom niza intervjua. Suočen sa reakcijom javnosti, Je je rekao paparacima da planira da se kandiduje za predsednika SAD na izborima 2024. Smešten u period skorašnjeg Jeovog ponašanja i navodne predsedničke kampanje, ovaj dokumentarac prati nagrađivanog novinara Mobina Azhara na putu do SAD-a, u pokušaju da otkrije kako je jedan od najslavnijih umetnika u Americi postao glasnogovornik mržnje i podela.

programme.title: Raspeće je zakazano za 14 sati
programme.desc: Pratite nagrađivanog reditelja, dokumentaristu i avanturistu, Lasea Spanga Olsena, dok kreće u avanturu na Filipine kako bi izveo eksperiment na vlastitom tijelu, koji završava njegovim raspećem i ekserima od 12 centimetara kroz ruke i stopala. Lase Spang Olsen, koji je proveo čitav život rizikujući svoje zdravlje (radio je kao filmski kaskader preko 35 godina), iznenada je doživeo nesreću za koju su lekari rekli da će biti smrtonosna. Na operacionom stolu, rečeno mu je da se verovatno neće probuditi i da bi trebalo da se oprosti od bližnjih. Nesreća se dogodila malo nakon što se Lase vratio kući sa snimanja filma na Filipinima, koji prati ljude koji se svake godine razapinju ekserima kroz ruke i stopala kako bi ostvarili kontakt s Bogom, razgovarali s njim i postigli dogovor o stvarima koje su im potrebne. Tri meseca nakon što se Lase vratio u Dansku, stigla mu je poruka na telefon. Poruka je stigla od verskog vođe sa Filipina, i u njoj je pisalo: "Pij vodu _ nešto nije u redu s tvojim stomakom". Lase nije popio vodu, i tri sata kasnije ležao je na operacionom stolu u bolnici, što je mogao izbeći da je poslušao poruku. Zadesile su ga smrtonosne okolnosti, i lekari su mislili da neće preživeti, pa su mu rekli da se oprosti od bližnjih. Ali dok je ležao sam u operacionoj sali, bilo mu je teško da se oprosti. Tada je Lase odlučio da će, ako preživi, otići na Filipine i naučiti da veruje u Boga, kako bi imao s kim da razgovara sledeći put kada bude umirao. Njegov test će biti da bude razapet na Veliki petak i da na tom mestu ostvari kontakt s Bogom. Jedini problem je bio što Lase nije verovao u Boga.

programme.title: Ljubav i seks
programme.desc: Kao i mnoge druge zemlje Latinske Amerike, Meksiko se, kada je reč o seksu, često povezuje sa mačizmom i verskim konzervativizmom. Ipak, glavni grad je oduvek bio jedan od najprogresivnijih u regionu, dok pojedini autohtoni narodi pokazuju toleranciju prema seksualnim manjinama kakva ne postoji ni u mnogim evropskim zemljama. Meksičko društvo, sa 130 miliona stanovnika, složeno je i puno suprotnosti.

programme.title: Iz pakla: Uhvaćeno kamerom
programme.desc: Zapanjujući stvarni snimci, od najsmešnijih do najdramatičnijih, pokazuju šta sve može poći po krivu na našim putovanjima, tokom praznika, na poslu i u našim domovima. Otkrivamo neverovatne trenutke _ sudare koji su gotovo završili smrću, ljute komšije i razloge zašto nikada _ nikada _ ne smete ostavljati decu bez nadzora _ sve snimljeno kamerama i telefonima, a ispričano od strane onih koji su preživeli da ispričaju svoju priču. Psiholozi i industrijski stručnjaci takođe razmatraju različite anksioznosti koje utiču na situacije u kojima se svakodnevno nalazimo.

programme.title: Iz pakla: Uhvaćeno kamerom
programme.desc: Zapanjujući stvarni snimci, od najsmešnijih do najdramatičnijih, pokazuju šta sve može poći po krivu na našim putovanjima, tokom praznika, na poslu i u našim domovima. programme.title: Seks i ubistvo
programme.desc: Seks i ubistvo su često povezani u krivičnim istragama; a detektivi otkrivaju prljave tajne, skandalozne seksualne afere, zavisnosti od seksa na mreži, ljubomoru i zapanjujuće iščašene fantazije, tražeći motive za ubistvo.

programme.title: Nestali avion MH370: Nova istraga
programme.desc: Nestanak leta Malaysia Airlinesa 370 je potpuna misterija, istovremeno zastrašujuća i fascinantna. Sedam godina nakon katastrofe, suočen sa odsustvom bilo kakvog uverljivog objašnjenja i strahom od nepoznatog, ljudski um nastavlja da traga za odgovorima. Svaka od hipoteza je smislena, ali nijedna ne rešava misteriju u potpunosti. Istraga objavljuje svedočenja ljudi koji do sada nikada nisu javno govorili.

programme.title: Velike inženjerske greške
programme.desc: Ljudi se bave gradnjom duže od 10.000 godina; mi smo stručnjaci za građevinu, pa ipak, svake godine slušamo nove priče o graditeljskim greškama iz celog sveta. Emisija Velike inženjerske greške ispituje sve njih, od onih nezamislivih do suludih, kako bismo pokazali epske neuspehe i granične slučajeve o kojima inženjeri radije ne bi pričali. Uz pomoć dizajnerskih timova, svedoka i niza stručnjaka, analiziramo šta je to pošlo po zlu u slučaju svih propalih zgrada, istražujemo zbog čega su ostale zataškane i otkrivamo kako inženjeri danas pokušavaju da ih poprave. U petoj sezoni, između ostalih priča iz celog sveta, istražujemo šta je uzrok pada ogromnog krana u Njujorku i ispitujemo obrušavanje skela na gradilištu mosta u Španiji. U međuvremenu, u Australiji, eksplozivi ne uspevaju da sruše veliki silos; a šta je uzrok velikog pada mosta u austrijskoj prestonici Beču? Od nebodera u Mančesteru u Britaniji pa sve do građevine koja je potonula u Berlinu, otkrivamo inženjerske greške koje su dovele do haosa.

programme.title: Kako nastaje serijski ubica?
programme.desc: Šta pokreće serijskog ubicu? Za svakog od 10 višestrukih ubica koji su predstavljeni, serijal Kako se postaje serijski ubica nudi odgovor. Najmlađi serijski ubica u Americi je bio mišljenja da je dovoljan razlog da ubije jednu od svojih žrtava to što je bila vlasnikom glasnog psa. Jedna žena je tvrdila da ima pravo da ubija muškarce zbog onoga što je pretrpela u mladosti. Razlozi koje svaki ubica navodi za ubistva analiziraju se forenzički u seriji prepunoj napetih detektivskih priča, potresnih iskaza u prvom licu i snimaka intervjua iz soba za ispitivanje, dok i sami detektivi pokušavaju da razumeju postupke serijskih ubica naspram kojih sede. Svedočimo prvom transrodnom serijskom ubici na svetu, gledamo verovatno sledeću žrtvu višestrukog ubice koja je puštena na slobodu i slušamo jeziv glas najgoreg serijskog ubice iz Konektikata, dok za njihovu smrt okrivljuje sopstvene žrtve. Kako se postaje serijski ubica: serija koja nam pomaže da razumemo šta to navodi nekoga da ubije — i da ubija ponovo i ponovo.

programme.title: Greška ubice
programme.desc: Služeći se dirljivim intervjuima i dramatičnim rekonstrukcijama, emisija "Greška ubice" istražuje fatalne greške koje su na kraju vodile do hapšenja. Priča svake žrtve je ispričana pomoću toka policijske istrage, tokom kojih su detektivi gradili slučajeve od najmanjih dokaza. Mrlje krvi, snimci sa skrivenih nadzornih kamera, pogrešna reč kazana u pogrešnom trenutku... Šta od toga može da oda ubicu? To otkrivamo na kraju svake epizode koja nosi intrigu, izazov i složenu tematiku, u seriji koja je dirljiva, ali i upućuje nas u proces istrage. Sve zavisi od jednog malog dokaza... A ako se dođe do njega, ubica ostaje slobodan.

programme.title: Ubistvo mi je donelo slavu
programme.desc: Ispitujemo ubice koji su dobili pažnju javnosti kada su njihovi zločini stvorili medijsko ludilo. Uznemirujuća psihologija iza ubistva dugo je bila izvorni materijal za televiziju, knjige i filmove, ali zašto određene ubice zaslužuju pažnju miliona? Svaka jednočasovna epizoda ovog serijala predstavlja dramsku rekreaciju dobro poznatih zločina, pomoću arhivskog materijala i dubinskih komentara ljudi koji su povezani sa slučajem, koji pomažu da se razmota zamršena ličnost koja je došla pod svetlost reflektora. Komentator u svakoj epizodi je pisac i kriminološki reporter, Stiv Heling, koji je pratio nekoliko poznatih slučajeva, uključujući i slučajeve nestanka Natali Holovej i Lejsi Piterson.

programme.title: DNK dokazi
programme.desc: Pomoću revolucije u forenzici, zastareli slučajevi širom sveta se napokon rešavaju, a emisija "DNK dokazi" istražuje i prenosi priče najneverovatnijih slučajeva koji su do sada rešeni. Pomoću iskaza svedoka, novih razgovora, arhivskih snimaka i dramatičnih rekonstrukcija, "DNK dokazi" donosi uzbudljiv televizijski program koji će nam otkriti nove i dinamične oblike borbe protiv kriminala.

programme.title: Ubistva na društvenim mrežama
programme.desc: Ubistva na društvenim mrežama vraćaju se s dva nova uznemirujuća slučaja koji naglašavaju uticaj društvenih mreža na kriminal. Kada je 27-godišnja Ema Klarkson ubijena, njena porodica koristi društvene medije kako bi prikupila ključne informacije koje pomažu u hapšenju njenog ubice. U drugom slučaju, 29-godišnja učiteljica Abi Fišer misteriozno nestaje, što je navelo istražitelje da otkriju zagonetne objave na društvenim mrežama koje otkrivaju skrivene veze i tajne.
